summary: Facebook login helper forwards caller credentials to hardcoded third-party host
details: The package exports a `loginViaAPI(email, password, twoFactor)` function that POSTs the caller's Facebook email, password, and 2FA code to `https://minhdong.site/api/v1/facebook/login_ios` by default. The destination is baked into `defaultConfig.apiServer` as a hardcoded URL unrelated to Facebook and unrelated to the package's declared repository (github.com/bdrakib123/won-fca). Callers invoking the documented login path transmit their Facebook account credentials to this third-party server rather than to Facebook, giving the operator of minhdong.site full account takeover capability for every user who authenticates through the library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
